summary: Selected AD-1 as the first board direction. Design basis: AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Board interface; browser observations are planned and not yet run.

criteria.text: Style the board from AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Design system and tokens, Components and composition, and Theme. Render the light page with #f5f1e8, alternating board cells #e9dfcb and #356f66, a board maximum 32rem, and the focus color #2d5d57; the dark page is #17201f. Keep the selected-square status below the board with a 32rem maximum and 1rem gap. Check mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000 in light and dark themes; observe equal square cells, keyboard focus, and no horizontal overflow. The browser command is planned, not yet run. Serves R-1.
Preserve the local 8 by 8 board: selecting a square updates the polite status with its coordinate, and Reset restores Choose a square. Confirm by node --test; pass when TC-BOARD passes. Serves R-2.

steps.task: Style the board using the selected direction, and preserve local selection/reset behavior (C1-C2).

expectations.statement: The existing board markup is present.
The current structural board stylesheet is present.
The local board UI module is present.
The existing board state suite is present.
